blocks.x: Fulfillment is throughput economics: pick rates, dock scheduling, labor allocation and inventory truth. Orchestrated robots, vision-verified quality and agentic labor planning compound into cost-per-order leadership. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in slotting and pick-path, wave/order batching, labor planning, with dock scheduling close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
In Warehousing & Fulfillment, the recurring pressure points:

items: Cycle-count programs lag; phantom stock breaks promises.
Shift planning vs. volume waves manual; overtime and missed SLAs.
Slotting decisions quarterly; travel waste permanent.
Cost per order by process unknown; improvements guessed.

blocks.x: Capability in Warehousing & Fulfillment is not abstract: each domain lands as a named build on a named workflow. The patterns below are what we deploy there.
